question: Under what condition can a mind fixed on that object remain uncut even when the body is being severed?
premises: The body may be in the process of being cut.
A mind fixed on that object remains oriented elsewhere.
Such fixation prevents the cutting from affecting that mind.
inference: A mind gone to that object is not cut in the same way as the body being severed.
uncertainties: Extent of separation between mind and body remains unspecified
plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that object is not cut when the body is being cut, so too is it unaffected.
